description: Type the daemon's git 404 for a repository without commits. Observed live 2026-11-04 (daemon on Daytona Cloud v0.229.2): GET /git/status on a freshly initialized repository answers 404 {"message":"not found: reference not found","source":"DAYTONA_DAEMON","code":"NOT_FOUND"}: HEAD names no commit yet.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The repository has no commit for HEAD to name yet (HTTP 404 "not found: reference not found").
